messages:
Alex (support): heads up — acct "Nexaflow" paused. Procurement told them they need an internal requisition code and approver name before releasing PO. Ticket #SUP-3421. Invoice can't be issued until PO present. Can sales/finance help? :clipboard:

Jordan (sales): pinging @Maya-accounts. We demoed earlier; client uses Coupa. Do we have a PO number yet?

Maya (acct exec): Customer emailed this morning, says their system will only accept invoices with a field `req_code` and `approver_email`. They gave placeholder `REQ-2024-881` but procurement insists on official PO. Asking for sample invoice format — I'll ask them to generate a PO.

Samir (finance): We need: 1) PO number 2) Approver name 3) GL/cost center 4) VAT/EORI if EU. If they can't supply PO, we can issue proforma but won't recognize in AR. What's the customer's billing cadence?

Alex (support): monthly in arrears; started trial usage in Jan. They need to be invoiced this cycle. If procurement delays, revenue won't be recognized.

Maya (acct exec): I asked customer for signed PO + approver contact. They replied 'procurement requires the vendor to upload W-9 and MSA' — attaching upload links. Copied their snippet:

```
Required fields:
  - PO number
  - Approver Name (full)
  - Cost Center
  - Tax ID / VAT
  - Signed MSA (if > $10k)
```

Anna (legal): we already have a signed MSA on file (2023-06-12). I'll attach to the vendor portal if needed.

Eli-bot: Proforma invoice generated: PRO-9887. Not approved for AR posting.

Samir (finance): If they can provide the PO by EOD PDT we can include in this cycle. Otherwise we'll push to next month. Maya — can you escalate on the procurement contact? Include approver email so we can enter into accounting system.

Maya (acct exec): Escalating now to procurement lead: @procurement_lead. Also asked customer for their internal `req_code` and approver email (requested screenshot of their Coupa screen). :email:

Jordan (sales): FYI I offered to jump on a quick call with procurement to unblock. If it helps, schedule 15m.

Maya (acct exec): Customer replied: 'We will not issue official PO until vendor completes tax forms. Vendor portal link: https://procure.nexaflow.com/upload' — procurement lead expects vendor to create vendor profile.

Samir (finance): Quick checklist for vendor profile:
- W-9 or W-8
- VAT certificate
- Contact person + email
- Bank wiring details

Alex (support): Can we provisionally attach invoice metadata so once PO arrives we can match automatically? Devs: @Lina-eng can you add `metadata.req_code` field to invoice export? This will only help if they include req_code in PO.

Lina (eng): Can do; small change to billing-export pipeline. ETA 2 business days.

Maya (acct exec): Great. For now I've sent them a template PO they can copy (see below). Hoping to get official PO within 24 hours.

```
Sample PO template:
Vendor: Redwood Inference
PO#: ___________
Approver: ___________
Cost Center: ___________
Amount: $____________
Notes: Include req_code: ________
```

Samir (finance): Thanks. Keep me posted. If they refuse to provide PO we can send proforma + request C-level approval for exceptions.

Alex (support): Thanks everyone. I'll keep thread updated once we hear back. :white_check_mark:
